visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with brown hair tied back, wearing a white off-the-shoulder polka-dot dress, stands in front of a large concrete building on a university campus. She smiles and gestures with her hands while speaking directly to the camera. The background shows university architecture and some greenery under an overcast sky. A large circular logo of National Taiwan University is overlaid on the left side of the frame. (2) The scene cuts rapidly between various students in an indoor setting. They are holding microphones and talking with animated facial expressions, giving thumbs-up gestures or nodding. The background consists of a music studio with guitars hanging on the wall and wooden paneling. Some variety-show style text overlays appear around them. (3) A young man in a white t-shirt is shown in a medium shot, sitting and playing an acoustic guitar with a percussive fingerstyle technique. He uses his right hand to strike the body of the guitar while his left hand moves quickly across the fretboard. He is in a studio room with windows showing a city background and acoustic foam or decorative wood panels on the walls. (4) The woman from the first phase is now in the studio sitting next to the male guitarist. Both are holding acoustic guitars. She looks at him as she speaks, and then they both look down at their instruments to begin a synchronized playing sequence. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting their movements and the texture of the instruments.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female voice speaking in a bright, energetic tone at a moderate speed. There is a light, melodic acoustic background music playing underneath. (2) At six seconds, a hard cut leads to a sequence of overlapping student voices, predominantly male, expressing agreement and enthusiasm. The background music remains consistent but is layered with rapid verbal interjections. (3) At twelve seconds, the audio shifts dramatically as the sound of a percussive fingerstyle guitar performance takes center stage. You hear the sharp, clear transients of fingers slapping the guitar strings and wood, creating a rhythmic impact SFX integrated into the melody. The tempo is brisk and steady. (4) At twenty-three seconds, a transition occurs as the female host returns with dialogue, speaking to the male guitarist. The acoustic signature shifts to a studio environment. (5) At twenty-seven seconds, a distinct vocal count-in 'One, two, one, two, three, four' is heard, followed by a sharp snapping sound or click that functions as a rhythmic anchor. (6) The video concludes with a final percussive thud or slap on the guitar bodies as both players execute a synchronized rhythmic movement.
